_comment: Hand-curated display-name overrides for the WG-client catalog extraction (consumed by extract_ship_names.py; priority: this file > game texts > prettified entity name). Covers the CN-server exclusive hulls whose non-Chinese catalog slots carry WG's pinyin transliteration instead of the ship's own hanzi name — no official non-Chinese rendering exists, so every language shows the hanzi. Also covers isolated locale slots the client's MO catalogs left empty at extraction time (e.g. PASA210's fr/es/ko); patch the shipped ship_names.json artifact with the same values so the next extraction reproduces it. Keys: index -> {langLoc: name}. Keep zh-CN and zh-SG values identical (same script).
